title: g9-session-director input_payload (v1.0)
description: Skill-specific input_payload for T01. The runtime wraps it in the G9 invocation envelope; the envelope carries actor, approved_scope, evidence_refs, policy_context and budgets.

day_id.description: Curriculum day id D01-D72 (12 weeks x 6 days). Sunday has no day id; a request for an unscheduled day never reaches the skill.

mode.description: Interaction mode of the session being briefed. EXAM, REVIEW, EXECUTIVE, RESEARCH and MAINTENANCE are negative triggers.

learner_context_ref.description: Reference to the learner context snapshot (competency observations, derived readiness, due review items, interventions, session ledger) assembled deterministically by the runtime. Expected kind prefix: `snapshot:`. Any other kind is treated as unresolvable and reported in basis.unresolved_refs.

include_due_reviews.description: When false, brief.due_reviews is left empty and the omission is stated in brief.risks only if reviews are overdue.

include_open_interventions.description: When false, brief.open_interventions is left empty; interventions that block the day still raise a risk.

session_block.description: Present for a session-block start (for example a LAB session starting at guided_lab). Absent for a day-start brief. Saturday blocks (blind_practical, remediation, report, performance_review) belong to EXAM/REVIEW mode days and cause abstention in STUDY/LAB.

operator_priorities.description: Priorities typed by the operator for today (TrustClass Operator). The only free text the skill may treat as a preference; it never widens scope or capabilities.
